accepted_limits: This is a focused inbound ODT to DOCX smoke using a valid ODT zip input produced by a controlled current DOCX to ODT rerun after the ODT route fix.
The checked-in fixture stores normalized python-docx readback semantics and output sizes rather than committing generated DOCX binaries with environment-specific metadata.

The smoke proves ODT inbound support for one representative document; it does not close LibreOffice-only fallback, WPS application fidelity beyond focused rich roundtrip, comments/fields/revisions/complex layout, or broad old-system binary artifact comparison.
